pattern.description: Regular-expression pattern (RE2 linear syntax) to search for by default; use literal=true to treat it as exact text.

path.description: CFS canonical absolute directory or file path to search.

include.description: Optional file filter glob such as '**/*.md'.

literal.description: Treat the pattern literally instead of as a regular expression. Defaults to false.

multiline.description: Allow matches to span multiple lines. Defaults to false.

limit.description: Positive maximum number of matches to return. Defaults to 100.

timeout_seconds.description: Positive search timeout in seconds. Defaults to 15.
